findings.quote: The microreactor was capped with a teflon pressure cap and placed into pre-heated aluminum block at 80 oC.
findings.message: The standalone HeatChill step represents apparatus preheating as an additional process heating operation without a vessel. The following HeatChill step already captures heating the reaction. Preserve the preheated-block placement detail as an unmapped action instead.
The GC/MS completion check before solvent removal is omitted. Preserve it as an unmapped action because the allowed operations do not represent analytical monitoring.
